items.question: Within how many days will this retailer credit your refund after checking a return made online or by pick-up?
items.fact: Refunds credited within 4-15 days after returns are checked

items.question: Can Shoexpress Credit Notes be redeemed in Centrepoint stores?
items.gold: No, they must be redeemed online or in a Shoexpress store.
items.fact: Shoexpress Credit Notes not redeemable in Centrepoint stores
